name: Watarase Shirayuki
source:
The leader and soul of the seven hero, combining both beauty and passion, Shirayuki “Snow White” is the key to this world. Being able to talk to the “King of the world tree”, who can bend the rules of reality, she is also nicknamed the Princess of Impossibility by her enemies.

While she acts polite and classy most of the time, when it comes to [url=/c4312]Yuu[/url], there will be flying kicks.

[Taken from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2012/01/08/legend7-review]Warum's review[/url].]
